title: Euro Style Wall Mount Toilet Paper Holder 7.5-Inch Solid Brass Military Camo Farmhouse Industrial Pipe Allied Brass
description:
Organize your bathroom with the unique outdoor-inspired aesthetic of this 7.5-inch European style wall mount toilet paper holder or tissue dispenser. Crafted from solid brass for enduring, rust-free performance, this accessory features a distinctive military camouflage finish that brings a rugged farmhouse or industrial feel to your space. The open-ended European design ensures quick and effortless roll changes, while the industrial pipe-style fittings provide a secure, wall-mounted installation. Part of the coordinated Camo collection, this durable holder is designed to provide years of reliable service. The choice of superior brass materials makes this item free from corrosion and rust, even in high-moisture environments.

Highlights:
- Premium solid brass construction for long-lasting performance
- European style open-ended arm for quick toilet tissue roll changes
- Industrial pipe fittings and farmhouse camouflage theme
- Space-saving wall mount design with color-coordinated mounting hardware
- Protected with lifetime materials for a decorative and clean finish

Specifications:
- Material: Solid Brass
- Style: Farmhouse / Industrial
- Dimensions: 7.5-In L x 3-In H x 3.6-In W
- Installation: Wall mount hardware included
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime
